searchText: Stateless call in 12 minutes Ideally we would like to get a team (either a client team, or a team working within a (fork of a) client's codebase) focused on figuring out "state expiry": https://ethresear.ch/t/resurrection-conflict-minimized-state-bounding-take-2/8739/17 The ideas I have for that are the offering of funding and a general call-to-action where we try to get broader visibility that there's a problem worth working on. Unfortunately, I also know that in general, the people who have the knowledge and expertise to do this tend to already have a completely full "plate". I'd be curious to hear from any of the client teams out there what your thoughts are on this. Are you interested? What's standing in the way of you saying "yes"? is quilt a possibility here? seems like they've had some success recently working on 1559 in geth as well as the initial 3074 implementation. though statelessness seems like a much broader scope than either of these we're a possibility! but our plate is pretty full for the next few months, so i'll hold off until those projects die down a bit
